# What should you charge to open and close this pool?

> Free pool opening and closing price calculator: enter the pool size, cover, water condition, crew and chemical costs, and get a price for each visit, a season bundle and stops per day. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
